name: Perturbed Friedmann Universe in Bardeen's Potentials

coordinates.name: Longitudinal gauge (conformal Newtonian)

parameters.description: Potential in $g_{\eta\eta}$ ($|\Phi| \ll 1$), Bardeen's $\Phi_A$; in the Newtonian limit it is the Newtonian potential over $c^2$
Potential in the metric of space ($|\Psi| \ll 1$), Bardeen's $-\Phi_H$; it equals $\Phi$ wherever the matter carries no anisotropic stress

coordinates.convention: We use the conformal time $\eta$, with $a\,d\eta = c\,dt$, and comoving Cartesian coordinates $(x, y, z)$, all lengths.

coordinates.name: Longitudinal gauge in curved space

parameters.description: Potential in $g_{\eta\eta}$ ($|\Phi| \ll 1$), Bardeen's $\Phi_A$; in the Newtonian limit it is the Newtonian potential over $c^2$
Potential in the metric of space ($|\Psi| \ll 1$), Bardeen's $-\Phi_H$; it equals $\Phi$ wherever the matter carries no anisotropic stress

coordinates.convention: We use the conformal time $\eta$, with $a\,d\eta = c\,dt$, and comoving Cartesian coordinates $(x, y, z)$, all lengths, in which space is conformally flat.

coordinates.name: Synchronous gauge

parameters.description: Perturbation of the trace of the metric of space ($|\psi| \ll 1$)
Potential of the traceless part of the metric of space, an area ($|\partial_i\partial_j E| \ll 1$)

coordinates.convention: We use the conformal time $\eta$, with $a\,d\eta = c\,dt$, and comoving Cartesian coordinates $(x, y, z)$, all lengths.
